text:
nora: Hey team — heads up, I might need to start my parental leave 1 week earlier than planned due to a medical follow-up for the baby. It would cover the weekend oncall shift next Friday-Sunday. Any quick guidance on coverage + paperwork?
michelle: Sorry to hear that, nora — hope all is OK. We can absolutely help. First: submit the parental leave form (link below) so we have the dates for payroll/benefits. Second: start a coverage thread with your manager to confirm who picks up the weekend.
people-ops-bot: Parental leave form: https://intranet.redwood/hr/leave-form — please attach any medical docs if available. Processing typically takes 3 business days.
ajay: I can take the handoff for the demo on Friday AM. Need a short checklist from you for the runbook and a calendar invite change.
leo: I can cover Sat night oncall. Tag me with the runbook link and escalation contacts.
nora: Thanks ajay + leo, appreciate it. Runbook is at /docs/oncall/runbooks/demo-night.md. Quick checklist I usually leave: 1) deploy tag to prod, 2) warm cache before demo, 3) contact list (ops, dev). I'll paste the checklist now:
```
- deploy: release/2026.03.demo
- warm cache: curl -s http://cache-service/prime?key=demo
- rollback: revert release/2026.03.demo
- escalation: ajay -> leo -> infra-oncall
```
nora: Also payroll — will the unpaid FMLA portion start immediately or after company-paid weeks? Need to plan finances.
emily: Hi Nora — once we have the submitted leave form and approval, payroll applies company-paid leave first (up to your plan's weeks) then unpaid FMLA as applicable. If you want exact pay estimates for those specific dates, DM me and I can run the proration.
michelle: For coverage docs, please add a short note in the team's calendar event and update the oncall Rota (Google Sheet). If you prefer, we can create a temp contractor request to cover extended shifts — that takes ~5-7 business days to onboard.
nora: OK I'll submit the form today and attach the note to the calendar. Ajay/Leo — can you confirm that the weekend is covered once I submit? If yes I'll mark the dates as leave in Lighthouse.
ajay: Confirmed from my side for Friday AM demo. Once you submit we good.
leo: Confirmed for Sat night. If anything changes ping me, I'll be on call. :thumbsup:
michelle: Great — when you submit, cc people-ops and set your leave type to "parental (medical start)" so the system routes correctly. If you need emergency childcare funds or travel reimbursement, open a ticket with receipts and tag @people-ops.
nora: Thanks all — filing the form now and will follow up once it's accepted. Really appreciate the quick coverage help.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Attaching medical docs speeds approval. Estimated processing: 72 hours after submission.
